tooltip.noitacraft.spark_bolt: A weak but enchanting sparkling projectile
tooltip.noitacraft.spark_bolt_trigger: A spark bolt that casts another spell upon collision
tooltip.noitacraft.spark_bolt_timer: A spark bolt that casts another spell after a timer runs out
tooltip.noitacraft.more_light: Makes a projectile emit a lot more light
tooltip.noitacraft.chainsaw: A good tool for cutting meat. Also has some magical properties...
tooltip.noitacraft.sawblade: Summons a large, serrated disc with a curious flight pattern
tooltip.noitacraft.hollow_egg: Summons an otherwise empty egg that casts a spell upon cracking open
tooltip.noitacraft.double_scatter: Simultaneously casts 2 spells with low accuracy
tooltip.noitacraft.triple_scatter: Simultaneously casts 3 spells with low accuracy
tooltip.noitacraft.quad_scatter: Simultaneously casts 4 spells with low accuracy
tooltip.noitacraft.bounces_plus: Makes a projectile bounce on impact
tooltip.noitacraft.recharge_minus: Reduces the time between spell casts
tooltip.noitacraft.speed_plus: Increases the speed at which a projectile flies through the air
tooltip.noitacraft.lifetime_plus: Increases the lifetime of a spell
tooltip.noitacraft.heavy_spread: Gives a projectile a much lower cast delay, but no respect to your aim
tooltip.noitacraft.heavy_shot: Greatly increases the damage done by a projectile, at the cost of its speed
tooltip.noitacraft.bloodlust: A projectile gains a hefty damage boost, but is also able to hurt you
tooltip.noitacraft.spiral_arc: A projectile flies in a spiralling pattern
